alert: ledger-service: worker restart loop with growing processing backlog
logs:
2026-07-12T08:10:10Z ledger-service-node-1 WARN background processing backlog continues to increase
2026-07-12T08:11:21Z ledger-service-node-2 ERROR worker failed while processing an incoming event
2026-07-12T08:12:32Z ledger-service-node-3 WARN retry threshold reached for a processing task
2026-07-12T08:13:43Z ledger-service-node-4 ERROR processing loop terminated unexpectedly
truth_root_cause: A poison message with a malformed payload crashed the consumer on every retry, so consumer lag kept growing
truth_fix: Moved the offending offset to the dead-letter topic, restarted the consumer group, and added schema validation before publishing

alert: search-indexer: background jobs failing during output operations
logs:
2026-07-17T08:11:10Z search-indexer-node-1 WARN local write operations are taking longer than normal
2026-07-17T08:12:21Z search-indexer-node-2 ERROR application failed while writing required output
2026-07-17T08:13:32Z search-indexer-node-3 WARN scheduled task did not complete within its execution window
2026-07-17T08:14:43Z search-indexer-node-4 ERROR temporary output operation failed
truth_root_cause: The node disk filled up because log rotation was misconfigured after a base image change
truth_fix: Re-enabled logrotate with 7 day retention, cleared old logs, and added a disk usage alert at 80 percent

alert: payments-api: elevated 5xx errors and rising latency under load
logs:
2026-08-01T08:12:10Z payments-api-node-1 WARN request latency increased above the normal service budget
2026-08-01T08:13:21Z payments-api-node-2 ERROR upstream operation timed out while handling request
2026-08-01T08:14:32Z payments-api-node-3 WARN active requests are queueing behind slow operations
2026-08-01T08:15:43Z payments-api-node-4 ERROR request failed after repeated backend timeouts
truth_root_cause: Database connection pool exhausted because connections leaked behind slow queries that never timed out
truth_fix: Raised the pool limit to 50, enabled idle-connection reaping, and added a 5 second statement timeout

alert: auth-gateway: downstream response times increased sharply
logs:
2026-08-07T08:13:10Z auth-gateway-node-1 WARN downstream response time increased above the normal range
2026-08-07T08:14:21Z auth-gateway-node-2 ERROR request exceeded dependency timeout budget
2026-08-07T08:15:32Z auth-gateway-node-3 WARN repeated backend requests detected during traffic spike
2026-08-07T08:16:43Z auth-gateway-node-4 ERROR request failed after downstream retries were exhausted
truth_root_cause: Redis reached maxmemory and evicted hot keys, causing a cache stampede onto the primary database
truth_fix: Added TTL jitter, switched the eviction policy to allkeys-lru, raised maxmemory, and added request coalescing on hot keys

alert: auth-gateway: service-to-service requests failing without a new release
logs:
2026-08-15T08:14:10Z auth-gateway-node-1 WARN downstream integration response rate dropped sharply
2026-08-15T08:15:21Z auth-gateway-node-2 ERROR request to dependency was rejected
2026-08-15T08:16:32Z auth-gateway-node-3 WARN authorization failures increased across multiple instances
2026-08-15T08:17:43Z auth-gateway-node-4 ERROR retry budget exhausted while contacting dependency
truth_root_cause: An internal TLS certificate or service secret expired because the scheduled rotation job had been failing silently
truth_fix: Rotated the certificate manually, fixed the rotation job permissions, and added an expiry alert at 14 days
